messages:
zoe: Quick heads-up while cutting the sample-app SDK: running `yarn typegen` produced a regen diff that changes a TS overload ordering and causes the smoke tests to fail locally. Repro: `git checkout release && yarn && yarn typegen && git --no-pager diff`
arjun: Can you paste the minimal diff?
zoe: tiny but breaking for positional callers:
```diff
- sendBatch(ids: string[], opts?: {priority?: number, retry?: boolean})
+ sendBatch(ids: string[], retry?: boolean, opts?: {priority?: number})
```
pat: Yikes. Thats a positional breaking change for TS. Did the OpenAPI change?
zoe: Nope, openapi.yaml untouched. Using `@redwood/typegen` v0.12.3. Looks like a generator re-grouping/flattening heuristic changed the emitted overloads.
meera: Our changelog automation inspected only a comment tweak and labeled the SDK release as patch. Semantic mismatch: changelog bot thinks patch but signatures disagree.
changelog-bot: changelog-bot note: applied label "auto:patch" to PR #278 (rule: docs-only)
regen-bot: regen-bot: created PR #278 by @zoe  "typegen: avoid reordering optional tuple params" (CI: queued)
arjun: Short-term plan: hold the release, revert the sample-app SDK artifact if it's already published, and treat this as semver-review.
pat: For mitigation we have two choices: publish a 0.12.4 patch that restores prior overload order, or revert and force a minor if we decide the new ordering is intended.
meera: Id prefer a conservative patch to restore previous signatures and update changelog rules so signature diffs require manual review. We need to avoid surprising downstream consumers.
arjun: I'll draft a small change in typegen to prefer stable ordering when multiple optional groups are present and push a unit test asserting deterministic overload order. If tests pass we can cut 0.12.4.
zoe: Revert PR opened for sample-app artifacts: https://git.redwood.ai/p/sample-apps/pulls/278  tagging @meera for release ops decision
pat: Also add a regen-diff gate in CI that fails merges when generated TS signatures reorder without any OpenAPI schema delta. That would've blocked this earlier.
meera: Filing follow-ups: 1) add deterministic overload-order unit test in typegen CI, 2) add regen-diff signature-order guard, 3) update changelog-bot to mark signature diffs as "semver:review", 4) short postmortem if revert merges.
arjun: Will add the test and the small fix; linking a reproducer gist with openapi fragment and local `yarn typegen` output: https://gist.github.com/arjun/regen-repro-217
zoe: Holding the release until 0.12.4 is published and the sample-app smoke suite is green. Will report back once CI is green. :thumbsup:
